description: One person who saw it. Recorded as a row rather than as a line of free text because a witness is somebody an investigator has to go back to: they need a name, a way to reach them, and a note of whether their account has been taken yet. A comma-separated string cannot say 'we still have not interviewed Miguel', which is the single most useful thing a half-finished investigation knows.

fields.description: Their Employee id, where they work here. Empty for a contractor, a delivery driver or a member of the public — all of whom witness farm accidents and none of whom are on the payroll.
fields.label: Employee

fields.description: Whether their account has been taken. THE OUTSTANDING-WORK FLAG: an investigation cannot close while a witness named here has no statement, because 'we knew he saw it and never asked him' is the finding that survives every other one.
fields.label: Statement Taken
